changelog: **Sales team page `/sales/team` (#3779, MARKETING).** Every rep of the tenant can open it from the sales menu (`Team`). It shows: the team's active records and how many sit in each stage (the tenant's own labels and order); new leads, wins and losses this week and this month; the open pipeline's estimated value per currency (minor units, never converted); and one row per seller (open records, stage split, wins this week and this month, overdue follow-ups — counts only). The ranked leaderboard reuses `salesTargetRule` (`wonCountsByOwner` / `rankLeaderboard`) and gains a week window (`weekRange()`: UTC, Monday-start, half-open like `periodRange()`); `/sales`'s leaderboard card gets a *This week* column. Ranking is by wins only — no points, streaks or activity counts. `lostCountsByOwner()` reads a loss as the first move into an off-path stage. `salesLeaderboardForReps` now defaults to `'true'` (read only in MARKETING); an admin can still switch it off. Names and counts only, tenant-scoped by hand, `count`/`groupBy` on the request path.

en: New Team page in sales: how many records the whole team follows, where they stand, what came in, was won and was lost this week and this month — and a leaderboard by deals won.
tr: Satışta yeni Ekip sayfası: tüm ekibin kaç kaydı takip ettiği, bu kayıtların nerede durduğu, bu hafta ve bu ay ne geldiği, ne kazanıldığı ve ne kaybedildiği — ve kazanılan anlaşmalara göre bir liderlik tablosu.
de: Neue Team-Seite im Vertrieb: wie viele Datensätze das ganze Team betreut, wo sie stehen, was diese Woche und diesen Monat hinzukam, gewonnen und verloren wurde — und eine Rangliste nach gewonnenen Deals.
